verdict.rationale: Relay's bill pay lets users upload bills, automate approvals with multi-step rules, and pay vendors. Expense categorization syncs to QuickBooks/Xero, which covers some of the routing and coding parts of the story. There is no evidence of purchase-order matching or of AI-driven automatic coding of vendor invoices, and one community user notes external payments still need manual execution. Missing for 10: invoice-to-PO matching, automatic GL coding of bills specifically, end-to-end automated routing to payment, independent hands-on corroboration of bill-pay automation.
